summary: Introduces the IOAM Direct Export (DEX) option type for in situ OAM. Rather than carrying telemetry data inside packets, the option triggers the data to be exported directly from network nodes for collection. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Instead of packets carrying notes all the way along, each stop mails its notes straight to the office. The packet just carries the signal to do that.

questions: how does ioam export telemetry data
